candidates.name: local_agentkernel_lite_100m_bitnet_v11
candidates.risk: Must not be loaded/trained until architecture/tokenizer/loss-mask compatibility and provenance are audited.
candidates.why: 113.5M encoder-decoder AgentKernel Lite export, closest local artifact to the target model size and architecture.

candidates.name: PeytonT/repo-state-grounding
candidates.risk: Use as side teacher/ranker first, not as core generator.
candidates.why: MiniLM-style text-classification model trained for repo-state grounding; directly aligned with verified_transition_record state evidence.

candidates.name: PeytonT/jepa-repo-state
candidates.why: Feature-extraction model for repo-state representation; useful for representation distillation into structured heads.

candidates.name: PeytonT/cross-encoder-reranker
candidates.risk: Must be calibrated; never use as sole truth source.
candidates.why: Cross-encoder reranker maps task/evidence pairs to relevance; matches recovered Stage8721/8722 calibration direction.

candidates.name: PeytonT/candidate-row-reranker
candidates.risk: Must remain advisory behind deterministic junk/authority gates.
candidates.why: Can support objective-aware dataset ranking before rows create gradients.

candidates.name: PeytonT/verifier-accept-policy
candidates.risk: Cannot replace tests/static analyzers; use only as learned prior.
candidates.why: Text-classification model aligned with verification acceptance; useful for reward/value targets after exact verifier checks.

candidates.name: PeytonT/span-infill-gate
candidates.risk: Must obey deterministic budget/source authority overlays.
candidates.why: Classifier for whether span infill is appropriate; aligns with bounded decoder and patch-operator phases.

candidates.name: PeytonT/bug-localization
candidates.why: Repo classifier over bug localization; maps directly to maintenance cognition spine.

candidates.name: PeytonT/cross-modal-retrieval
candidates.risk: Retrieval evidence only; not target truth.
candidates.why: Feature-extraction model for paper/code retrieval, useful for knowledge-transfer policy.

candidates.name: PeytonT/paper-to-code
candidates.risk: Do not distill unverified outputs directly; verifier/source grounding required.
candidates.why: FLAN-T5 adapter trained for paper-to-code transfer; useful as synthetic teacher into verified transition records.

candidates.name: PeytonT/repo-conditioned-adapter
candidates.risk: Base is FLAN-T5-base, not the 100M target; use as teacher/advisory source.
candidates.why: T5 adapter conditioned on repository information; likely helpful for proposal generation after gates pass.

candidates.name: PeytonT/query-rewriter
candidates.risk: Queries must be judged by retrieval utility, not copied into target truth.
candidates.why: Directly supports transition action RETRIEVE_CONTEXT and repository/library search.

candidates.name: PeytonT/world-planner-adapter
candidates.risk: Use behind verifier and transition-record schema; not a runtime controller yet.
candidates.why: Planning adapter can propose action traces for verification/mining.

candidates.name: PeytonT/unified-knowledge-model
candidates.risk: Too broad for direct student seed; verify outputs and avoid shortcut teacher leakage.
candidates.why: Broad T5 adapter over research-library objectives; may provide useful proposals.

candidates.name: local_m1_lite_and_scibert_onnx
candidates.why: Distilled/scibert paper embedding models with documented M1 vector space; useful for external retrieval, not generator weights.

decision.default_use: teacher/tool/ranker/retrieval sidecar unless explicit compatibility audit promotes a model
do_not_do: do not initialize the 100M maintainer from arbitrary T5/LLM adapters
do not let teacher outputs bypass verified_transition_record_v1 gates
do not download or execute models in this stage

integration_order: inventory local AgentKernel Lite architecture/tokenizer compatibility
register frozen side teachers/rankers as non-authoritative evidence providers
add VTR provenance refs for teacher/tool suggestions
only then consider representation distillation or adapter fusion
